description.sl: Drevesa in rože s čebelarjem Aldom: bor in breza, javor in topol, oljka in murva, češnja in jablana, storž in želod, korenina in steblo, popek in cvetni list, trn, cveteti in oveneti, živa meja, bršljan in mah, vrtnica, vijolica, mak in tulipan, sivka, dišeč.
description.en: Trees and flowers with Apicoltore Aldo: the pine and the birch, the maple and the poplar, the olive and the mulberry, the cherry and the apple tree, the pine cone and the acorn, the root and the stem, the bud and the petal, the thorn, blooming and wilting, the hedge, ivy and moss, the rose, the violet, the poppy and the tulip, lavender, scented.
description.de: Bäume und Blumen mit Apicoltore Aldo: Kiefer und Birke, Ahorn und Pappel, Olivenbaum und Maulbeerbaum, Kirsch- und Apfelbaum, Tannenzapfen und Eichel, Wurzel und Stiel, Knospe und Blütenblatt, der Dorn, blühen und welken, die Hecke, Efeu und Moos, Rose, Veilchen, Mohn und Tulpe, Lavendel, duftend.

review: it, sl, en, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
